propositions: Dependabot PR #125 proposes two dependency bumps: zizmor 1.28.0 → 1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0 → 2.0.0, but only the zizmor bump is safe to land; the mcp 2.0 bump requires migration work deferred to ticket 732b
Landing zizmor 1.29.0 requires updating the exact pin in pyproject.toml dev group and regenerating uv.lock via 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' to match CI's lock-check gate
mcp 2.0 removes the fastmcp module imported by src/rebar/mcp_server.py:570 and scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:72, along with other v1 import paths that remain at risk under 2.0
The mcp bump was already investigated and rejected in ticket 1dfd; re-proposing it in PR #125 would duplicate that prior decision and contradict the same path-2 rule
zizmor 1.29.0 must pass 'make lint' on release.yml with no new findings, and all gates (typecheck, test, lock-check) must pass locally and in CI
